Shape.description: Declare a row shape: one typed field per line, with `| None` where the column may be NULL.

Unique key.description: The fields of a unique key, after `name = ` on a line of a shape.

Enum.description: Declare an enum with its labels on one line.

Source.description: Connect a shape to a database table.

Query.description: Declare a query: from, where, select.

Grouped query.description: Declare a query with one row per group.

Join query.description: Declare a query that names another input with let, joins it and writes the match in on.

Join.description: Name another input with let, then join it and write the match in on.

Count matching rows.description: Count the rows of each group whose test is True, in a select item of a grouped query.

First value.description: The value at the first row of each group; the order ends in a unique key of the source.

Last value.description: The value at the last row of each group; the order ends in a unique key of the source.

Def.description: Declare a pure inline function; each call is replaced by its body.

Relationship.description: Name a match between two shapes once and call it in on.

Import.description: Import a declaration of another module of an explicit-module project, with its kind.

Export.description: Export a declaration of this module of an explicit-module project, with its kind.
